title: Cute Axolotls
description: Gives the Axolotl a :3 face with big eyes.
body:
# What it does:
Gives all of the axolotl textures **(Axolotl in a bucket, Spawn egg of axolotl and the entity)** a colon 3 face!

This texture pack is for axolotls to _look cute and so pettable!!!!!_
